messages.subject: SpectroMinetoMSstatsTMTFormat - Error in vecseq
parts:
Hello,

I wanted to try your MSstatsTMT package, but I encountered this error:

> input1 <- SpectroMinetoMSstatsTMTFormat(data, annotation)
.....
Error in vecseq(f__, len__, if (allow.cartesian || notjoin || !anyDuplicated(f__,  :
  Join results in 20360352 rows; more than 10181488 = nrow(x)+nrow(i). Check for duplicate key values in i each of which join to the same group in x over and over again.
  If that's ok, try by=.EACHI to run j for each group to avoid the large allocation.
  If you are sure you wish to proceed, rerun with allow.cartesian=TRUE. Otherwise, please search for this error message in the FAQ, Wiki, Stack Overflow and data.table issue tracker for advice.

The dataset I have is in Spectromine format (912364 entries, ~360MB) and for the annotation file I got the following information:

> we don't have technical replicates.
> BioReplicate is a consecutive sample number, since they are all different samples
> Conditions we don't actually have any. so also consecutive number.
  Each sample is an individual plant, whose protein profile we want to compare with each other.
> The mixtures correspond to our pool samples.
> The FAIMS CV1 and CV2 are actually 2 fractionations of the same pool.


When I try it with my first 10k lines, it runs through

input2 <- SpectroMinetoMSstatsTMTFormat(data[1:10000,], annotation)

I tried adding the "allow.cartesian" option, but it is ignored. I think I need to change it in an internal function.

Can you help me out?
I attached the first 11k rows which also run into the same error and the annotation file.


Best,
Evelina
